notes: Timeline = audio/baseline.wav (Suno WAV, 48 kHz). Tempo is NOT constant: it drifts from ~130.1 to ~133.8 BPM (mean 131.70); beats[] is a per-beat grid (librosa DP tracker re-fitted to kick + snare attacks of the Demucs drum stem, residual MAD ~2-4 ms), so use beats[] / downbeats[] (the engine interpolates between them), not bpm. Bar phase: beat 0 is a downbeat; snares on beats 2 and 4. Sections start on downbeats (see SECTION_BARS in analysis/analyze.py). Envelopes: 100 fps, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each normalised to its 99th percentile, 0..1. low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = Demucs stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1]: kick (473), snare (225), hat (407) from the drum stem; vocal = note onsets of the vocal stem (incl. vocal chops).
